verdict.rationale: Canny documents a native integrations directory covering common tools: Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp, Asana, Discord, Fathom and Fireflies, plus Gong, Intercom and Slack capture via Autopilot. However, the 'in just a few clicks' setup ease is only evidenced for the MCP connection ('secure sign-in… no engineering'), not for the native integrations, so the story's ease-of-connection element is unproven for most tools. missing for 10: documented click-through setup flow for native integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration of quick setup, detail beyond one-line directory blurbs.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect common third-party tools to my feedback workspace in just a few clicks

citations.quote: Native integrations keep the rest of your stack in sync.
Automatically capture feedback from Gong, Intercom, Slack, and dozens of other sources
Send feedback to Jira, link it to existing issues, and sync statuses. Only for Jira Cloud.
Send feedback to Linear, link it to existing issues, and sync statuses.
Add Canny's MCP server to ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor with a secure sign-in. No API keys, no engineering.
